candidates.name: Current NVIDIA SegFormer-B0 ADE20K

code.official_note: The current implementation uses the NVIDIA SegFormer family, whose official repository limits use to non-commercial research or evaluation absent a separate grant. Installed code identity is SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 `git ls-tree -r --full-tree HEAD` manifest, including its trailing LF.

weights.official_note: The HF B0 repository links to the same NVIDIA license. The installed identity is the canonical SHA-256 of the strictly loaded model state recorded by the runtime observer.

notes: CG-SEM-001 validated mapping semantics, not commercial model rights.
The current semantic provider must remain non-commercial/research-only or be replaced/licensed separately.
Project model/checkpoint execution is authorized, but that authorization does not change NVIDIA's upstream license.

candidates.name: Video Depth Anything Small

code.official_note: The frozen official repository carries Apache-2.0 and explicitly distinguishes the Apache-2.0 Small model from non-commercial Base/Large variants. Installed code identity is SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 git tree manifest, including its trailing LF.

weights.official_note: The immutable official Hugging Face revision declares Apache-2.0. Its LFS SHA-256 and 116,440,756-byte size exactly match the installed Small checkpoint; the frozen upstream README explicitly scopes Apache-2.0 to Small.

notes: A real 150-frame Windows CUDA shadow preserves float depth and records checkpoint/state identity, 0.380 inference FPS, and peak GPU memory.
This is engineering runtime evidence, not human Gold quality evidence, and it does not authorize the model to replace the default depth provider.
Base and Large variants remain excluded because their upstream weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0.
Project public redistribution remains unauthorized even though the upstream Small license permits redistribution subject to Apache-2.0 terms.

candidates.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (Transformers)

code.official_note: The official repository is Apache-2.0 and explicitly states that the Small model uses Apache-2.0. Installed code identity is SHA-256 of the canonical UTF-8 git tree manifest.

weights.official_note: The official Transformers checkpoint is pinned to the verified HF revision; installed identity is the canonical SHA-256 of the strictly loaded model state.

notes: The 7423-frame tracked-mask observation binds the source, exact model state, five 16-bit FFV1 assets and decoded video identities.
This frame-depth candidate is distinct from Video Depth Anything Small and uses Farneback propagation between 83 model anchors.
Project authorization permits local model/checkpoint work but does not grant rights beyond Apache-2.0.
